name: Christine
beschreibung:
Quietly and idyllically situated on the sunny plateau of Schwoich, Pension Christine welcomes guests with genuine Tyrolean warmth. The cosy rooms provide restful comfort and pleasing views over surrounding fields and peaks.

Summer brings opportunities for cycling, swimming in lakes, and hiking towards the Kaiser mountains, while winter offers scenic cross-country trails and peaceful snowy walks.
kurzbeschreibung: Pension Christine in Schwoich offers a warm family atmosphere and peaceful relaxation in the scenic Kufsteinerland.
